entities.summary: The Kharkiv National Agrarian University named after V.V.Dokuchayev is a former state-sponsored higher education institution of IV level of accreditation subordinated to the Ministry of Education and Science of Ukraine. Located in the village of Dokuchayivske, Kharkiv Raion, Kharkiv Oblast, in 2021 joined the State University of Biotechnology as its constituent part.
